basics.summary: I'm passionate about building software and proving it through my projects. As a freelancer I've delivered functional solutions, working both independently and in teams, applying solid full stack development practices. I'm always learning because I know there's room to keep improving and contributing more.
project.Lisa App.description: An educational and inclusive language-learning app used by deaf individuals to learn Spanish — my first real-world project with a genuine positive social impact.
project.System-A.description: An Inventory and Machinery Management System. This was my final academic project — my first contact with a real codebase and full stack development.
project.H Path.description: A portfolio built in pure HTML and CSS, a collection of exercises representing the foundational languages of web programming.
